visual_review.visible_evidence: At 2.267s (target_0) through 5.267s (target_7), the operator is manipulating the black housing and inserting a shaft/gear assembly, consistent with starting the rotor assembly. The adapter plate (a separate black circular component) is not attached to the housing during this interval. At 32.533s (target_8) through 35.533s (target_15), the operator picks up the adapter plate from the red tray and attaches it to the shaft assembly. Thus, the rotor assembly actions began before the adapter plate attachment.
limitations: Sparse sampling between 5.267s and 32.533s means intermediate steps are not visible, but the start times of the two distinct actions are clearly separated in the provided frames.
